title: Discrete viscoelastic model of deformable immune cell migration through confined tumor microchannels
task: Model large-scale deformations of immune cells migrating through confined tumor microchannels
key_results: Particle-based discrete viscoelastic model validated against microfluidic experiments; mechanistic insights into cellular stiffness effects on migration efficiency
comments: Bridges computational and experimental approaches, though specific quantitative metrics on migration efficiency or stiffness sensitivity are not provided in abstract.

model_io.model: Discrete particle-based cell deformation model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cellular stiffness variations affect migration efficiency through confined micropores
hypotheses.result: Model captures large deformations and provides mechanistic insights validated by microfluidic data

title: Profilin-regulated actin polymerization dynamics at high monomer concentrations
task: Characterize profilin-regulated actin polymerization kinetics and growth precision at high monomer concentrations
key_results: Four-reaction kinetic model predicts Michaelis-Menten-like saturation of F-actin growth speed; profilin-regulated polymerization increases precision approaching thermodynamic uncertainty relation bounds; unique stall force indicates energetically balanced profilin-driven polymerization
comments: Rigorous theoretical framework connecting microscopic kinetics to macroscopic growth dynamics and precision, with clear predictions for future single-filament experiments.

model_io.model: Four-reaction kinetic model of profilin-actin polymerization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Profilin binding decouples pure actin and profilin-actin polymerization cycles, controlling maximal polymerization speed
hypotheses.result: Model predicts Michaelis-Menten saturation at high profilin-actin concentrations; growth speed exhibits profilin-dependent Michaelis constant

hypotheses.hypothesis: Profilin regulation increases polymerization precision by reducing stochastic fluctuations
hypotheses.result: Length diffusivity decreases substantially; Fano factor approaches thermodynamic uncertainty bounds under profilin regulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: A unique stall force indicates absence of auxiliary energy coupling in profilin-driven polymerization
hypotheses.result: Identification of energetically balanced regime allows experimental discrimination of profilin-only versus coupled polymerization mechanisms

title: Allosteric network rewiring governs enzyme functional duality via a distal switch
task: Identify distal allosteric switch governing functional duality in meso-DAPDH
key_results: Residue M176 acts as distal switch decoupling amination and deamination activities; substrate-dependent network reorganization correlates with distinct catalytic outcomes (activity retention, inhibition, functional decoupling)
comments: Elegant demonstration of allosteric control from a distant site, though the mechanistic link between contact-correlation network topology and substrate selectivity could benefit from higher-resolution structural validation.

model_io.model: Molecular dynamics and network analysis of StDAPDH

hypotheses.hypothesis: M176 substitutions remodel allosteric network to decouple amination and deamination pathways
hypotheses.result: Mutations at M176 cause substrate-dependent network reorganization and selective activity loss

hypotheses.hypothesis: Distal network modulation can engineer substrate-dependent enzyme activities
hypotheses.result: Specific residue-network combinations enable functional decoupling while maintaining activity

title: Biomass-derived bamboo photonic crystals for narrowband lasing
task: Engineer biocompatible photonic crystals for narrowband multicolor lasing
key_results: Narrowband multicolor lasing achieved using bamboo-derived photonic crystals coupled with quantum dots; simplified preparation leveraging natural hierarchical microstructure of bamboo
comments: Clever exploitation of bamboo's cellulose-lignin composition for photonic bandgap engineering, though biological imaging/sensing performance metrics are not quantified in the abstract.

title: Targeting mutant p53 aggregates in pancreatic cancer using an autophagy-targeting chimera
task: Target mutant p53 amyloid-like aggregates in pancreatic cancer using autophagy-targeting chimeric molecules
key_results: ATC-37 exhibited dual concentration-dependent mechanism: low concentrations promoted autophagic degradation of mutant p53 aggregates; high concentrations induced p62-dependent sequestration leading to proteotoxic death; in vivo xenografts showed significant tumor growth inhibition and enhanced radiation response
comments: The aggregation-state-directed strategy elegantly overcomes structural heterogeneity of p53 mutations, but the therapeutic window between autophagic clearance and proteotoxic overload requires careful optimization for clinical translation.

model_io.model: PANC-1 pancreatic cancer cells with mutant p53
PANC-1 pancreatic cancer xenograft

hypotheses.hypothesis: Targeting β-sheet-rich mutant p53 aggregates via autophagy promotes their degradation

hypotheses.hypothesis: ATC-37 enhances radiation therapy response in mutant p53 tumors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ATC-37 enhanced radiation-induced tumor suppression in xenografts

title: A novel HIF1α stabilizer prevents apoptosis and promotes a senescence-like phenotype in photoreceptor cells
task: Protect photoreceptors from hypoxia-induced apoptosis using HIF1α stabilization
key_results: Stabilizer 1a reduced cleaved caspase-3 and annexin V labeling, decreased ROS levels, preserved ATP, and attenuated photoreceptor apoptosis in vivo after retinal detachment
comments: The induction of reversible senescence as a protective mechanism is intriguing but raises questions about long-term functional recovery and whether senescence-associated secretory factors could complicate therapeutic outcomes.

Murine retinal detachment model

hypotheses.hypothesis: HIF1α stabilization protects photoreceptors from hypoxia-induced death

key_results: WASH recruits STX19 to phagosomes to promote lysosome-phagosome fusion; WASH deficiency impairs bacterial killing without affecting particle uptake
comments: The identification of STX19 as a critical WASH binding partner provides a mechanistic link between actin remodeling and SNARE-mediated membrane fusion, though the specific molecular determinants of WASH-STX19 interaction remain to be fully characterized.

title: Antagonistic second-messenger signalling coordinates Pseudomonas aeruginosa surface colonization and virulence
task: Characterize antagonistic cAMP-c-di-GMP signaling coordination during P. aeruginosa surface colonization
key_results: Initial surface contact triggers c-di-GMP-mediated stable attachment via bipolar T4P; progressive cAMP elevation enables twitching motility and virulence; both adhesion and motility are required for tissue invasion
comments: The elegant demonstration of reciprocal second-messenger signaling driving phenotypic heterogeneity in pathogenic biofilm formation provides valuable insight into bacterial colonization dynamics, though the specific environmental triggers for the cAMP transition require further characterization.

model_io.model: P. aeruginosa surface colonization assay
Human airway tissue model

hypotheses.result: Confirmed; airway tissue model demonstrates requirement for both functions

title: Effects of delayed inhalation therapy on apoptosis-related proteins and late remodeling after mixed-insult lung injury in rats
task: Evaluate delayed inhaled therapies on apoptosis-related proteins and fibrotic remodeling after mixed-insult acute lung injury
key_results: Placebo-treated animals showed 9.3-fold increased active caspase-3 and 2.8-fold increased Bax monomer; all three inhaled agents reduced caspase-3-immunopositive cells and partially normalized apoptosis profiles, with methylprednisolone and camostat significantly reducing histological injury scores
comments: The partial and differential efficacy of the three agents suggests distinct mechanisms of action on apoptosis pathways, but the clinical relevance of delayed monotherapy initiation (days 5-21) and translation to conventional pulmonary-only models remains uncertain.

model_io.model: Rat mixed-insult acute lung injury model (LPS priming + mechanical injury + LPS challenge)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Delayed inhaled modulation of apoptosis-related pathways reduces late remodeling after ALI

title: Reconstructing the human endometrium in vitro using co-cultures of endometrial epithelial organoids and stromal cells

comments: While co-culture significantly improves molecular fidelity, the system remains a simplified 2D approximation lacking vascularization, immune cells, and spatial architecture that would be present in vivo.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Epithelial-stromal communication is mediated by secreted factors

title: Host cell identity shapes the replication and evolution of Drosophila C virus

key_results: Mesodermal cells supported 5-10 fold higher viral RNA and protein production than glial or S2 cells; after 15 serial passages, evolved viruses showed improved replication in corresponding cell type without altering fly infectivity; recurrent VP3 mutation (R270H) emerged independently in 3 S2-passaged lineages
comments: The observation that structural proteins accumulate mutations and show positive selection while nonstructural proteins remain conserved provides mechanistic insight into RNA virus evolution, though the subtle effects of the VP3 substitution on capsid function warrant structural and functional validation.

Serial passage evolution (15 generations) in mesodermal or S2 cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structural proteins accumulate mutations under cell-type-specific selection

comments: Tg-based mechanistic framework elegantly explains diffusivity variations but validation against experimental Li-ion battery cycling data is needed to confirm practical relevance.

model_io.model: Machine-learning potentials for Li–Si/Ge/Sn/Pb systems

hypotheses.hypothesis: DLi increases monotonically with Li content and temperature
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; trends align with experimental observations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Arrhenius extrapolation from high-T data accurately predicts room-temperature diffusivity
hypotheses.result: Refuted; extrapolation overestimates by 1–2 orders, particularly in Li-poor phases

hypotheses.hypothesis: Glass transition marks a sharp transition from localized to extended Li motion
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Li-poor phases show stronger cage-confinement below Tg

title: Software-defined polarization-diversity continuous-variable quantum key distribution heterodyne receiver
task: Develop polarization-diversity CV-QKD heterodyne receiver with software-defined demultiplexing
key_results: Composable finite-size secret key rate: 6.98 Mbps back-to-back, 0.29 Mbps over 25 km fiber; maintains stable performance under arbitrary polarization states; significantly reduces optical hardware vs conventional architectures
comments: Digital-domain polarization diversity is elegant and practical, though 25 km range typical for metro deployments; scalability to longer distances requires investigation.

model_io.model: Symmetric 3×3 beam-splitter heterodyne receiver with software-defined demultiplexing

hypotheses.hypothesis: Digital-domain polarization diversity maintains performance under arbitrary states
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; stable operation demonstrated

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hardware complexity reduction vs conventional architecture with no performance penalty
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; key rates and robustness achieved with simplified optics

title: Performance enhancement of electrohydrodynamic thruster using sub unit electrode configuration
task: Enhance electrohydrodynamic thruster thrust output through novel electrode configuration
key_results: Sub-unit electrode configuration increases thrust 27.59% (50.23→64.09 mN at 22 kV); sub-unit-plus configuration adds 7.19% further increase (68.70 mN total, 36.77% improvement over baseline)
comments: Incremental geometric optimization shows trade-offs between absolute thrust and efficiency; scalability and practical integration into propulsion systems unclear.

model_io.model: EHD thruster with variable electrode configurations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sub-unit structure increases thrust by optimizing ion acceleration field
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 27.59% improvement observed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sub-unit-plus further optimizes aerodynamic interactions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; additional 7.19% gain achieved

title: Agentic AI for inverse design in nanophotonics and meta-optics
task: Develop agentic AI framework for inverse design of nanophotonic structures with coordinated optimization and binary candidate evaluation
key_results: Four metagrating strategies yield diffraction efficiencies 79.4–90.9%; metagrating redesign improves efficiency 81.2% → 94.6%; metalens focusing efficiency (visible wavelengths) increased 40.0% → 65.2%; Bayer color router mean channel routing 50.3% → 54.7% under 125 nm minimum-feature constraint; solver-specific retrieval resolves interface errors unresolved by standalone configurations
comments: Agent-assisted multi-strategy approach demonstrates workflow value, but candidate selection by binary-structure performance vs peak optimization objective can diverge significantly—a practical limitation for automated design.

model_io.model: Agentic AI framework integrating literature reproduction, adjoint optimization, and binary evaluation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multiple optimization strategies from common initialization yield diverse final designs with different performance trade-offs
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; efficiencies 79.4–90.9% span wide range

hypotheses.hypothesis: Peak optimization objective and final binary efficiency produce consistent rankings
hypotheses.result: Refuted; different rankings observed, requiring separate final evaluation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Solver-specific error retrieval improves robustness vs standalone configuration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; interface error resolution demonstrated

title: Evolution of the vertical structure of heat waves in Europe at hourly resolution
task: Characterize subdaily vertical structure evolution of European heat wave types
key_results: Four heat wave types show contrasting patterns: near-surface type exhibits gradual upward build-up of temperature anomalies; omnipresent type shows rapid downward propagation from upper troposphere; nighttime decoupled layers occur only in near-surface type despite positive anomalies in other types
comments: High temporal and vertical resolution ERA5 data reveals mechanistically distinct heat wave drivers, though attribution to specific physical processes remains incomplete.

model_io.model: ERA5 reanalysis with hourly resolution

hypotheses.hypothesis: Near-surface heat waves involve gradual surface-upward warming buildup
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; only near-surface type shows this pattern

hypotheses.hypothesis: Omnipresent heat waves involve downward propagation from upper troposphere
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; rapid downward propagation observed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nighttime decoupled layers are universal across heat wave types with positive surface anomalies
hypotheses.result: Refuted; layers present only in near-surface type

title: Generalizable full-spectrum learning for recalibration-free refractometry with reflection-mode tilted fiber Bragg gratings
task: Enable recalibration-free refractometry using CNN-based full-spectrum learning on tilted fiber Bragg gratings
key_results: CNN pipeline generalizes across independently fabricated TFBG sensors (7° and 8° tilt angles); predicts spectra at untrained angles (6°, 9°) without recalibration; deterministic mode equalization with fixed amplitude scale from training sensors
comments: Strong generalization across independent sensors and angles is promising for practical deployment, though evaluation on only 2 trained angles limits robustness assessment.

model_io.model: Convolutional neural network with deterministic mode equalization
inputs: multimode TFBG reflection spectra at 7°/8° tilt angles

hypotheses.hypothesis: CNN trained on sensors at specific tilt angles generalizes to independent sensors at same angles
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; independent test sensors predicted accurately

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pipeline generalizes to tilt angles absent from training without recalibration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 6° and 9° angles predicted without adaptation

title: Selectively VO2-loaded terahertz metasurface for dual-state broadband polarization conversion and near-unity absorption
task: Design selectively VO₂-loaded terahertz metasurface with dual-state polarization conversion and absorption via conductivity switching
key_results: Insulating VO₂ state: cross-polarization conversion PCRₓ > 0.90 (1.515–2.585 THz), PCRᵧ > 0.90 (1.527–2.673 THz); metallic VO₂ state: absorption Aₓ > 0.90 (1.570–1.997 THz), peak 0.9997 at 1.805 THz; VO₂ dissipates 97.14% of power at peak; mesh convergence <1%; features retained under angular/tolerance variations
comments: Elegant single-unit-cell dual-functionality demonstrated numerically, but experimental validation of VO₂ switching speed and thermal stability under THz illumination needed for practical implementation.

model_io.model: VO₂-loaded ground-backed terahertz metasurface unit cell

hypotheses.hypothesis: VO₂ insulating state enables broadband reflective cross-polarization conversion
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PCR > 0.90 across octave bandwidth

hypotheses.hypothesis: VO₂ metallic state suppresses reflection and enables near-unity absorption via resonator-ground coupling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; peak absorption 0.9997 at design frequency

hypotheses.hypothesis: Design robustness sustained under realistic fabrication tolerances and oblique incidence
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; features maintained in tolerance/angular analysis

title: Experimental investigation of blade-tip leakage flow control in a low-speed axial compressor using natural aspiration through casing wall slot
task: Mitigate blade-tip leakage flow in low-speed axial compressors via passive casing-slot aspiration
key_results: Natural aspiration through circumferential slot increases pressure-rise coefficient ~1.2%; extends stable operating range (inlet-flow coefficient 0.28 vs 0.32 for plain casing)
comments: Passive mechanism shows promise but lacks quantification of admitted mass flow and efficiency impact, limiting mechanistic understanding of stall-inception suppression.

model_io.model: Low-speed axial compressor rotor at 1600 rpm

hypotheses.hypothesis: Passive air admission through casing slot weakens tip-leakage vortex
hypotheses.result: Partially supported; performance improvement observed but vortex weakening not independently confirmed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Treatment extends stable flow range by modifying near-tip boundary layer
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; extended operating envelope demonstrated
